issue.title: Mac pom glossary strand describes a stale NO POMODORO flash schedule
issue.description:
The `NO POMODORO` sentence in this strand is stale and should be rewritten to match the chezmoi README "Pomodoro menu bar" section, which is the mac pom spec.

Current text: "...which flashes as a green pill for its first minute on screen and then for one minute in every ten, restarting that cycle whenever the label reappears or the Mac wakes or unlocks."

Why it is wrong:

1. chezmoi commit 39f24434 (`feat(hammerspoon): flash NO POMODORO green every five minutes`, plan:202610/no_pomodoro_five_minute_flash.md) changed `MISSING_REMINDER_EVERY_SECONDS` from 600 to 300. That plan deliberately left this strand alone, so "one minute in every ten" has been wrong since then.
2. A follow-up tale proposed on 2026-10-06 (`sase_plan_no_pomodoro_delayed_first_flash.md`) keeps the label steady for its first minute on screen, flashes it for the second minute, and then keeps the existing one-minute-every-five-minutes windows. Those windows start at 5:00, 10:00, and so on after the label appears.

Proposed wording, once that tale has landed (check the chezmoi README first):

"...which stays steady for its first minute on screen, flashes as a green pill for its second minute, and then flashes for one minute every five minutes, counted from when it appeared. The cycle restarts whenever the label reappears or the Mac wakes or unlocks."

If that tale was rejected, describe the shipped behavior instead: "...for its first minute on screen and then for one minute in every five...".
